{{Quote|Upworlders, I think maybe we've got a problem.|Ilok|<ref name="CD" />}}
'''Ilok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Ilok witnessed a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] crash in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant undercity]]. The accident caused a [[Fire/Legends|fire]] and, outraged at the destruction caused by the collision, Ilok angrily confronted a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|spacers]] whom he believed were responsible.

==Biography==
Ilok was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who resided in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CD" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is placed in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' can be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> while walking through the Coruscant [[City/Legends|undercity]] with his associate, the [[Coruscani ogre]] [[Bartle]], Ilok witnessed a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by a group of [[Believers|Believer]]<ref name="CD" /> [[Sith cult|Sith-worshipping cultists]]<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> collide with a nearby building. The crash ignited a [[Fire/Legends|fire]] and Ilok joined a crowd of disgruntled local residents who were drawn to the scene, outraged at the devastation that had been brought to their neighborhood. A [[Heroes of Cularin|group of spacers]] in pursuit of the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] arrived at the wrecked speeder and an irate Ilok, suspecting that the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] had caused the crash, angrily confronted them to express his displeasure.<ref name="CD" />

{{RPG|''[[Coruscani Dawn]]''}}
A fight soon broke out between Ilok and the spacers. A Ilok's direction, Bartle and three [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] thugs who were among the crowd drawn to the crash site, [[Dure]], [[Krood]] and [[Sounac]], all joined the melee and attacked the spacers as well. Ilok, Bartle and the Trandoshans were subsequently defeated and the spacers departed to resume tracking the Believers.<ref name="CD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Ilok had dirty brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and his body had an odor of a rotten [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] combined with [[pineapple juice]]. When the Believers' speeder crashed in the Coruscant undercity he was riled by the destruction that resulted and was determined to express his consternation to the spacers that he believed were responsible. In addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]], Ilok was fluent in the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by his Coruscani ogre associate Bartle.<ref name="CD" />

==Equipment==
Ilok wore a [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] and pants that looked as if they had been sown together from old towels. He was also equipped with a [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]] and [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]].<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ilok featured in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Morrie Mullins]] that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign.<ref name="CD" />

In ''Coruscani Dawn'', the players roleplay as the spacers who encounter Ilok in the Coruscant undercity. When Ilok confronts them, the player characters can either attempt to defuse the tense situation via diplomacy or by applying a [[Mind trick/Legends|Jedi mind trick]] to Ilok, or instead by letting a fight break out. Ilok does not initiate combat with the player characters but fights back if provoked and commands Bartle to attack the spacers. If the player characters are in the middle or upper roleplaying experience tiers, Ilok and Bartle are joined in the brawl by a trio of Trandoshan thugs, otherwise the pair fight alone. If a fight does break out, it is possible for Ilok, Bartle and the Trandoshans to be incapacitated or [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Alternatively, Bartle can stop fighting either due to fear of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapons if any of the player characters ate wielding such blades, or out of boredom, which momentarily distracts Ilok and allows the player characters to flee the scene. The adventure also advises that the players' encounter with Ilok and Bartle can be cut-out from the gameplay of the players are short of [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="CD" />
